name: Extend the Bulwark
benefit:
If you are wearing medium or heavy armor and are adjacent to an ally who also has this feat, as a free action, you may give your ally a circumstance bonus to her AC equal to half the armor bonus provided by your armor. This bonus lasts for 1 round. During this round, you gain no bonus to your AC from your armor.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Armor Master's Handbook pg. 20
You can spend 5 stamina points either to use this feat without losing your own armor bonus to AC, or to use this feat to grant the bonus to an ally. (Magical Marketplace 6)
flavor: You can bolster a trained ally’s defenses by interposing your own armored body.
